reason: This PR is directly centered on planner/executor behavior: it changes hash join version/type gating in `pkg/planner/core/exhaust_physical_plans.go` and `pkg/executor/join/joinversion/join_version.go`. Disabling non-GA hash join types in v2 affects physical plan selection and join runtime behavior, and the surrounding integration/planner test updates reinforce that this is not an incidental touch.
